Official application-timeline PDF embedded in and linked from the record's own page: 'CHULA LINK SCHOLARSHIP 2026 ... Application Timeline Second Semester 2026'. Stage 1 'Application Period: Sep - 31 Oct'. Text extracted and read.

Chulalongkorn University's own news release announcing the 2026 Chula LINK Scholarship, confirming the full programme name, eligibility, coverage and the awarding office. This release describes the earlier (first-semester) cycle.

Faculty-level application procedure for the 2nd-semester cycle, issued by The Petroleum and Petrochemical College, Chulalongkorn University. Independently restates the application window 'From September, 2026 to October 31, 2026' and the record's own page URL as the application link.

awarding_body.detail: The page is the awarding body's own site (inter.chula.ac.th, the Office of International Affairs and Global Network), not an aggregator or news mirror. Its header reads 'The Office of International Affairs and Global Network', the sidebar lists 'Supported By: Chulalongkorn University' and 'Contact: Office of International Affairs and Global Network', and the footer gives the Chulalongkorn University Bangkok address. The university's own news release attributes the programme to Chulalongkorn University and names the same office as the contact point, confirming the record's body including the parent office.
awarding_body.quote: Supported By: Chulalongkorn University — Contact: Office of International Affairs and Global Network / For questions related to the scholarship program, please contact: The Office of International Affairs, Chulalongkorn University

deadline.detail: The cycle the page carries is currently open today (12 October 2026): the sidebar shows Status 'Open' and Deadline '31 Oct 2026', and the body states 'Application: Now - 31 October 2026'. The embedded official timeline PDF gives stage 1 'Application Period: Sep - 31 Oct', and the faculty procedure PDF restates 'From September, 2026 to October 31, 2026'. Today's date sits inside that window and 31 October 2026 is in the future, so the record's deadline of 31 October 2026 is confirmed as an open cycle.
deadline.quote: Application: Now - 31 October 2026 | Deadline: 31 Oct 2026 | Status: Open | Application Period: Sep - 31 Oct

eligibility.detail: Every distinct claim in the record's eligibility summary is confirmed on the page's own 'Who Can Apply?' list: international students not holding a Thai passport, admitted to or currently studying in the first semester at Chulalongkorn University, and enrolled in a Master's or doctoral programme. The university's news release states the same three conditions. The record's eligibility summary matches the page wording essentially verbatim. Additional faculty-level conditions (minimum GPA, English scores, age under 40) appear only in the Petroleum and Petrochemical College's own procedure document and are not part of the general eligibility the page publishes, so they are noted rather than treated as a contradiction.
eligibility.quote: Who Can Apply? International Students (Not Holding a Thai Passport) / Admitted to or currently studying in the first semester at Chulalongkorn University / Master's or Doctoral Degree Programs

funding.detail: The award is genuinely fully funded rather than tuition-only. The page lists three inclusions: 'Tuition Fees', 'Monthly Living Allowance' and 'Round-Trip Airfare'. That is full tuition plus a living stipend plus travel, which matches the record's 'Fully Funded' claim. The university's news release independently describes 'Full tuition fees / A monthly living allowance / Round-trip airfare'. Note that the page's own taxonomy sidebar labels the field 'Funding Type: Scholarship' rather than the words 'fully funded'; that is the site's category label, and the listed inclusions are what substantiate the record's claim.
funding.quote: Chula LINK Scholarship Includes: Tuition Fees / Monthly Living Allowance / Round-Trip Airfare

degree_levels.detail: The page offers the scholarship at Master's and doctoral level only: 'Master's or Doctoral Degree Programs', under a programme titled 'Chulalongkorn Leaders in International Networks and Knowledge Scholarship for International Students - Second Semester, Academic Year 2026'. This matches the record's degree_levels of 'Master's, PhD' and no other level is mentioned.

recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Read the awarding body's own page on 12 October 2026 in a browser session; a plain HTTP fetch of inter.chula.ac.th is intercepted by an Incapsula bot check and must not be treated as a dead link. The official timeline PDF on the page ('Chula-Link-Scholarship-2026-Timeline.pdf') confirms the same window: stage 1 'Application Period: Sep - 31 Oct'. The Chula LINK Scholarship 2026 runs in multiple cycles: an earlier first-semester cycle (deadline 24 May 2026, announced in the university's news release at chula.ac.th/en/news/298837/ and listed at inter.chula.ac.th/funding-opportunity/37857/) and the currently open second-semester cycle at /funding-opportunity/40290 with a 31 October 2026 deadline. Keep this record pointed at the second-semester listing and re-check it again around late October 2026, because the status flips to closed once 31 October 2026 passes. The site's own URL canonicalises with a trailing slash (/funding-opportunity/40290/) but both forms serve the same document.

notes_for_reviewer: The record is accurate as written and can be moved to active. Two things a person should decide. First, the OIA page's sidebar uses the site's own category 'Funding Type: Scholarship' and never prints the phrase 'fully funded' on the page itself; I judged the 'Fully Funded' claim confirmed because the page lists tuition fees, a monthly living allowance and round-trip airfare, which is what 'fully funded' means here, but if the catalogue wants strict provider wording the field could be reworded. Second, faculty-level documents (the Petroleum and Petrochemical College procedure PDF) impose extra conditions for their own applicants - minimum GPA 2.75 for master's, 2.75 at bachelor's and 3.25 at master's for doctoral, TOEFL/IELTS minimums, and age under 40 - and PPC applicants also apply to a different route. Those extra conditions are not published on the record's page and are not part of the record's eligibility summary, so they are recorded here rather than treated as a conflict.
